messages:
alex_cs: FYI customer (ACME) opened a priority ticket — after last night's rollout their markdown outputs in the API responses are malformed. Stop sequence `\`\`\`` (fence) is not terminating generation, or we get extra trailing backticks. They included a few examples.

priya_support: Can you paste the exact API request and the response they received? Also which model/version and when was the rollout?

alex_cs: Request payload they used (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-inference/redwood-v1.3.0",
  "input": "Here is a code example:\n```js\nconsole.log(\"hi\")\n```\nExplain what this does.",
  "stop": ["```"],
  "max_tokens": 300
}
```
Response they got (truncated):
```
...
This prints \"hi\" to the console.
``` ```

Note the fence is duplicated in the tail: they see a space + three backticks appended, or sometimes the closing fence is missing entirely and a bunch of tokens follow. This started after we deployed redwood-v1.3.0 to prod at 2025-11-09T03:20:00Z. Canary rollout looked fine.

jordan_eng: tagging eng-runtime for triage. @maya_ml FYI — any recent changes to post-processing or stop-sequence handling?

maya_ml: I pushed a change in text-normalization and stop-trim last week (commit 4a7b9c1). It tightened trimming of stop sequences to remove trailing whitespace tokens. Could be we over-aggressively strip whitespace around fenced code sequences.

jordan_eng: Ok can you confirm which model variant is serving in prod? Is it quantized or FP16? Also need the request_id from the customer logs.

alex_cs: Customer request id: rq_0b12f9e4. Model variant: redwood-v1.3.0-standard (FP16). We didn't change model weights, just serving binary and a small text handling patch.

priya_support: Customer is blocked — they embed code snippets in docs and the extra backticks break rendering. They asked for a rollback if possible. Any mitigation short-term?

sam_oncall: temporary mitigation: advise customer to post-process responses to strip a trailing /\`\`\` or normalize repeated fences. Also they can set stop sequences to include the literal fence + newline like "```\n" as a workaround.

jordan_eng: We'll try to reproduce locally using your payload. If we can reproduce, we'll either patch the trimming logic or revert the post-processing change. Could you also share a raw tokenization dump for rq_0b12f9e4? Need to see where the fence token is emitted and how the stop logic handles it.

alex_cs: Pasted token stream from the customer (token ids replaced with tokens for readability):
```
... , "\n", "```", " " , "```", "\n", "EOF"\n```
You can see the fence token appears, then we get a space and duplicate fence token. Looks like post-processing inserted an extra fence or failed to trim the next fence.

maya_ml: That aligns with the change I made — I added a normalization pass that collapses adjacent whitespace but it may be merging tokens incorrectly when a fence is split across tokens (e.g., backticks separated from newline). I'll run the unit tests against fence-heavy prompts.

priya_support: Customer consented to either rollback or hotfix. Which would be faster?

jordan_eng: Quickest path is to roll back the text-processing change in prod (revert commit 4a7b9c1) and push a hotfix to the branch with better token-boundary checks. I can schedule an emergency rollback — need approvals.

deploy-bot: rollout-redwood-v1.3.0 -> completed prod at 2025-11-09T03:20:01Z :package: (canary had been completed at 2025-11-09T02:45:00Z)

sam_oncall: If we roll back, we should patch the canary first and watch for 30m before full prod rollback. Also capture more request_ids to ensure not an isolated customer repro.

alex_cs: Will ask ACME for more samples and give them the workaround to post-strip trailing backticks. Sharing the request id and they agreed to try stop=["```\n"] for now.

jordan_eng: Assigned to eng-runtime. Action items: 1) reproduce using payload above and rq_0b12f9e4 locally (jordan) 2) if reproduced, revert text-processing commit 4a7b9c1 in prod (jordan/maya) 3) add token-boundary unit tests for fenced code (maya) 4) provide customer update and ETA (priya).

priya_support: Thanks — I'll update the ticket and tell the customer we're investigating and have a mitigation. Please post updates here. :thumbsup:

alex_cs: putting the ticket link in the internal case: CASE-4521.

jordan_eng: I'll post a short reproduce run in this thread when done. If anyone on this thread sees other customers with similar issues please drop request ids here.

maya_ml: preliminary local run suggests we can reproduce with the exact payload. I'll pair with jordan to craft a minimal fix.

sam_oncall: tagging incident rotation for visibility.

priya_support: marking this P1 until rollback or hotfix shipped.

(End of thread)
